dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Last time I was here, I had a Lohikeitto that was — even by my standards — absolutely flawless. I found myself returning frequently afterwards.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: But no matter how many times I return, I can never quite find that flavor again... Hah, guess there's a new chef in the kitchen. Again.
